body.name: etahat
body.def: \(\widehat\eta=(\widehat m,\widehat\pi,\widehat M_A,\widehat M_Z,\widehat f,\widehat w,\widehat W,\widehat B,\widehat d,\widehat D,\widehat R,\widehat N,\widehat h,\widehat G,\widehat G_{\tau_G}^{\dagger},\widehat b_{(\cdot)},\widehat b_U,\ell_{A,n},\ell_{Z,n})\) is recovered from one label-aligned product factorization on each training fold; every derived object, cutoff inverse, and leakage diagnostic is formed from that fitted law without querying a true support or rank
